An automated proof cannot fund testnet; the funded transfer below therefore runs on devnet through the same engine code, and testnet account A (0xc2329b5ba52ff3078da8d4f3d876fbe7ffab6b635770eb2746cb8a9c95ec19ef) can be funded by hand on the mint page to repeat it there.
Devnet faucet shape (verified live): POST https://faucet.devnet.aptoslabs.com/fund with JSON {"address","amount"} → HTTP 200 {"txn_hashes":["<64 hex, no 0x prefix>"]}.
